chapter.neroruins.expedition_notes.title: Expedition Notes
hook.neroruins.reveal_ruin.placeholder: Expedition Notes: a survey map has been reserved for you. Ruins are not charted yet, so it will be drawn once they are.
hook.neroruins.unlock_log.placeholder: Expedition Notes: a data-log entry has been reserved in your archive. The archive opens once ruins exist.
quest.neroruins.expedition_notes.bunker_: Find a Survey Bunker and climb down its ladder. Ruins you enter are written into your Expedition Record.
quest.neroruins.expedition_notes.codex_a: Archive all six logs of the chapter “The Ship That Waited” to unlock its Codex entry.
quest.neroruins.expedition_notes.codex_c: Archive all six logs of the chapter “The Meridian's Wake” to unlock its Codex entry.
quest.neroruins.expedition_notes.codex_e: Archive all six logs of the chapter “The First Shelter” to unlock its Codex entry.
quest.neroruins.expedition_notes.codex_g: Archive all six logs of the chapter “The Frozen Reach” to unlock its Codex entry.
Archive all six logs of the chapter “Roots in the Hull” to unlock its Codex entry.
quest.neroruins.expedition_notes.codex_l: Archive all six logs of the final chapter. You know now what was left open.
Archive all six logs of the chapter “Ash Without Fire” to unlock its Codex entry.
quest.neroruins.expedition_notes.codex_m: Archive all six logs of the chapter “A Catalogue of Silence” to unlock its Codex entry.
quest.neroruins.expedition_notes.codex_n: Archive all six logs of the chapter “The Unfixed Signal” to unlock its Codex entry.
quest.neroruins.expedition_notes.colony_: Someone on this server has opened the council vault of the colony on Glacira.
Walk into a Colony Field, the remains of the Survey's settlements.
quest.neroruins.expedition_notes.crash_s: Someone on this server has opened a vault aboard the Meridian on Cindara.
Enter a Crash Site. The Meridian lies half-buried on Cindara; smaller wrecks are everywhere.
quest.neroruins.expedition_notes.first_l: Read a data log, from a terminal or a data shard. Every expedition starts with a story someone left behind.
quest.neroruins.expedition_notes.first_r: Bring back a relic. Each one does something small while you hold it, and some open relic sockets.
quest.neroruins.expedition_notes.first_v: Somewhere on this server, someone has claimed a ruin vault for the first time.
quest.neroruins.expedition_notes.halcyon: Someone on this server has opened the captain's vault aboard the Halcyon Ark.
Board the Halcyon Ark, the Survey's broken generation ship in the station's void, or its severed section on Luna.
quest.neroruins.expedition_notes.keycard: Find a Survey keycard. Card readers deeper in the labs and wrecks ask for higher clearance.
quest.neroruins.expedition_notes.lattice: Someone on this server has opened the vault deep in the Lattice Citadel on Nyxara.
Enter a Lattice Temple. The Architects built in glyphs and resonance; their wayshrines stand on every world.
quest.neroruins.expedition_notes.plunder: Fifty vaults of a single ruin type have been claimed across this server. The galaxy is being picked clean.
quest.neroruins.expedition_notes.puzzle_: Open a Sealed Door by solving the puzzle beside it: glyphs, conduits, resonance pylons, a card reader or a relic socket.
quest.neroruins.expedition_notes.relic_h: Bring back three relics from the ruins you explore.
quest.neroruins.expedition_notes.sentine: Destroy a Sentinel. Ruin Spawners wake when you come close and only hold a few guardians each.
quest.neroruins.expedition_notes.survey_: Someone on this server has opened a vault in the Survey Lab under Mars.
Enter a Survey Lab. The largest one goes twelve floors under Mars.
quest.neroruins.expedition_notes.vault_c: Unseal a ruin vault and claim its reward. In a bunker, load each Ballast Plate with exactly as many items as its lights show.
log.neroruins.earth.1.title: The First Shelter · 1
log.neroruins.earth.1.speaker: Mira
log.neroruins.earth.1.body: We built these shelters for the return journey. The first ships left before we knew how long that journey might be.
log.neroruins.earth.2.title: The First Shelter · 2
log.neroruins.earth.2.speaker: Teren
log.neroruins.earth.2.body: The lamps are on an independent circuit. If the outer lights fail, the inner circuit still points to the door.
log.neroruins.earth.3.title: The First Shelter · 3
log.neroruins.earth.3.speaker: Nali
log.neroruins.earth.3.body: Leave medicine in both lockers. A shelter is only useful if the last arrival finds something in it.
log.neroruins.earth.4.title: The First Shelter · 4
log.neroruins.earth.4.speaker: Ilyra
log.neroruins.earth.4.body: The first signal was not a word. It repeated the interval between two pulses, then changed when our receiver moved.
log.neroruins.earth.5.title: The First Shelter · 5
log.neroruins.earth.5.speaker: Eda
log.neroruins.earth.5.body: Keep the departure records behind the marked lock. The pattern is written here because no expedition should need a second expedition to open it.
log.neroruins.earth.6.title: The First Shelter · 6
log.neroruins.earth.6.speaker: Mira
log.neroruins.earth.6.body: We called the route Halcyon. If you find this long after us, know that we left a way to learn what happened.
log.neroruins.luna.1.title: Ash Without Fire · 1
log.neroruins.luna.1.speaker: Mira
log.neroruins.luna.1.body: The dust holds a footprint longer than a promise. I marked our route on the inside wall so the next crew can follow it in a storm.
log.neroruins.luna.2.title: Ash Without Fire · 2
log.neroruins.luna.2.speaker: Teren
log.neroruins.luna.2.body: The sealed hatch still opens manually. A dead battery must never trap someone between two doors.
log.neroruins.luna.3.title: Ash Without Fire · 3
log.neroruins.luna.3.speaker: Nali
log.neroruins.luna.3.body: Two crew members heard the receiver click at the same time. Neither had touched it. We have stopped calling that a fault.
log.neroruins.luna.4.title: Ash Without Fire · 4
log.neroruins.luna.4.speaker: Ilyra
log.neroruins.luna.4.body: The fragment changes its intervals when a person moves. It may be measuring us rather than speaking to us.
log.neroruins.luna.5.title: Ash Without Fire · 5
log.neroruins.luna.5.speaker: Teren
log.neroruins.luna.5.body: The wall marks show the order the lights must wake. Resetting the panel is safe; the lock has no hidden timer.
log.neroruins.luna.6.title: Ash Without Fire · 6
log.neroruins.luna.6.speaker: Mira
log.neroruins.luna.6.body: We found the same dark stone beneath the Survey's own foundations. Someone had been here before our maps began.
log.neroruins.ark.1.title: The Ship That Waited · 1
log.neroruins.ark.1.speaker: Eda
log.neroruins.ark.1.body: The Ark was built to wait as long as our people needed. Its manifests include the sleeping crews, the seeds and the tools to start again.
log.neroruins.ark.2.title: The Ship That Waited · 2
log.neroruins.ark.2.speaker: Nali
log.neroruins.ark.2.body: The sleepers are patients, not cargo. Each pod has an independent release; check its indicator before touching the latch.
log.neroruins.ark.3.title: The Ship That Waited · 3
log.neroruins.ark.3.speaker: Seli
log.neroruins.ark.3.body: I counted the leaves again. The garden looks bigger when the lights turn on one row at a time.
log.neroruins.ark.4.title: The Ship That Waited · 4
log.neroruins.ark.4.speaker: Teren
log.neroruins.ark.4.body: We separated the ship's circuits so a single silent line could not shut every door. The visible junctions show which branch feeds each lamp.
log.neroruins.ark.5.title: The Ship That Waited · 5
log.neroruins.ark.5.speaker: Nali
log.neroruins.ark.5.body: The director left a seal here, where someone would look for help before looking for a command chair.
log.neroruins.ark.6.title: The Ship That Waited · 6
log.neroruins.ark.6.speaker: Eda
log.neroruins.ark.6.body: We released the stern when the shared controls stopped answering. The separation saved those aboard the forward section; I cannot report what followed.
log.neroruins.mars.1.title: A Catalogue of Silence · 1
log.neroruins.mars.1.speaker: Mira
log.neroruins.mars.1.body: Our instruments disagree about the sample's age. We sent the whole case below rather than taking a piece through the settlement.
log.neroruins.mars.2.title: A Catalogue of Silence · 2
log.neroruins.mars.2.speaker: Ilyra
log.neroruins.mars.2.body: The symbols are not an alphabet in the order we expected. Their arrangement changes with the material surrounding them.
log.neroruins.mars.3.title: A Catalogue of Silence · 3
log.neroruins.mars.3.speaker: Nali
log.neroruins.mars.3.body: No one handles the sample alone. We write down what changed, including what we thought before the test.
log.neroruins.mars.4.title: A Catalogue of Silence · 4
log.neroruins.mars.4.speaker: Teren
log.neroruins.mars.4.body: The network holds a copy of every experiment but gives different answers after each movement of the sample.
log.neroruins.mars.5.title: A Catalogue of Silence · 5
log.neroruins.mars.5.speaker: Ilyra
log.neroruins.mars.5.body: The wall records a sequence of changes: dark, bright, dark. It is a description, not a command.
log.neroruins.mars.6.title: A Catalogue of Silence · 6
log.neroruins.mars.6.speaker: Eda
log.neroruins.mars.6.body: We authorised a connection to the colony systems. The next report must include the settlements, not only the instruments.
log.neroruins.cindara.1.title: The Meridian's Wake · 1
log.neroruins.cindara.1.speaker: Mira
log.neroruins.cindara.1.body: The Meridian came down with its cargo hatches sealed. The scattered braces point back toward the surviving hull.
log.neroruins.cindara.2.title: The Meridian's Wake · 2
log.neroruins.cindara.2.speaker: Teren
log.neroruins.cindara.2.body: Heat fused the outer relays, but the inner loop is intact. Its path is painted on the wall beside the controls.
log.neroruins.cindara.3.title: The Meridian's Wake · 3
log.neroruins.cindara.3.speaker: Nali
log.neroruins.cindara.3.body: We treated burns in the loading bay before we knew whether the ship could land. The crew kept the sample case away from the patients.
log.neroruins.cindara.4.title: The Meridian's Wake · 4
log.neroruins.cindara.4.speaker: Ilyra
log.neroruins.cindara.4.body: A repeated signal followed us from Mars. It does not describe where we are; it describes what we connected.
log.neroruins.cindara.5.title: The Meridian's Wake · 5
log.neroruins.cindara.5.speaker: Teren
log.neroruins.cindara.5.body: The socket accepts the shaped key and gives it back after the latch moves. Do not leave the only key inside.
log.neroruins.cindara.6.title: The Meridian's Wake · 6
log.neroruins.cindara.6.speaker: Mira
log.neroruins.cindara.6.body: Our last transmission says to disconnect before the signal stops changing. We do not know whether anyone received it.
log.neroruins.glacira.1.title: The Frozen Reach · 1
log.neroruins.glacira.1.speaker: Seli
log.neroruins.glacira.1.body: The snow covered our old tracks before breakfast. We tied flags between the houses so everyone could find the hall.
log.neroruins.glacira.2.title: The Frozen Reach · 2
log.neroruins.glacira.2.speaker: Nali
log.neroruins.glacira.2.body: We keep the warming room open even when the network says it is empty. A quiet sensor is not proof that nobody needs help.
log.neroruins.glacira.3.title: The Frozen Reach · 3
log.neroruins.glacira.3.speaker: Teren
log.neroruins.glacira.3.body: A thermal core can heat one room without the main grid. The orange line is its input and the blue line carries heat.
log.neroruins.glacira.4.title: The Frozen Reach · 4
log.neroruins.glacira.4.speaker: Seli
log.neroruins.glacira.4.body: We learned to read the old symbols by copying them in frost. When the window warmed, our teacher made us write them again.
log.neroruins.glacira.5.title: The Frozen Reach · 5
log.neroruins.glacira.5.speaker: Eda
log.neroruins.glacira.5.body: Disconnect the settlement before opening the archive. The local latch stays powered by its own cell.
log.neroruins.glacira.6.title: The Frozen Reach · 6
log.neroruins.glacira.6.speaker: Nali
log.neroruins.glacira.6.body: The heaters returned when we cut the shared line. We have a little time to decide what to carry and whom to send.
log.neroruins.greenxertz.1.title: Roots in the Hull · 1
log.neroruins.greenxertz.1.speaker: Seli
log.neroruins.greenxertz.1.body: The vines reached the landing pad this season. We leave one path clear and let the rest grow where it can.
log.neroruins.greenxertz.2.title: Roots in the Hull · 2
log.neroruins.greenxertz.2.speaker: Mira
log.neroruins.greenxertz.2.body: These beds were empty when we arrived. The local growth has found every crack in the plating.
log.neroruins.greenxertz.3.title: Roots in the Hull · 3
log.neroruins.greenxertz.3.speaker: Nali
log.neroruins.greenxertz.3.body: We learned which spores to keep outside and which roots can be cooked. The old supply lists were a beginning, not a rule.
log.neroruins.greenxertz.4.title: Roots in the Hull · 4
log.neroruins.greenxertz.4.speaker: Ilyra
log.neroruins.greenxertz.4.body: The Lattice did not cause the vines. It records their arrival as another change in a place that once held metal.
log.neroruins.greenxertz.5.title: Roots in the Hull · 5
log.neroruins.greenxertz.5.speaker: Teren
log.neroruins.greenxertz.5.body: The old route is blocked by roots, so we moved the control to the wall everyone can reach. Its labels still match the plates.
log.neroruins.greenxertz.6.title: Roots in the Hull · 6
log.neroruins.greenxertz.6.speaker: Seli
log.neroruins.greenxertz.6.body: I was small when the Ark garden was all I knew. Here the garden is larger than the walls, and we are learning its names.
log.neroruins.nyxara.1.title: The Unfixed Signal · 1
log.neroruins.nyxara.1.speaker: Mira
log.neroruins.nyxara.1.body: There is enough light here to see the black stone against the horizon. The nearer markers face a building farther in.
log.neroruins.nyxara.2.title: The Unfixed Signal · 2
log.neroruins.nyxara.2.speaker: Ilyra
log.neroruins.nyxara.2.body: Our earlier translation assumed a command to hold. In this context the same mark means to stop holding.
log.neroruins.nyxara.3.title: The Unfixed Signal · 3
log.neroruins.nyxara.3.speaker: Teren
log.neroruins.nyxara.3.body: Nothing here failed from wear. The couplings were opened in a deliberate order, and the marks show that order.
log.neroruins.nyxara.4.title: The Unfixed Signal · 4
log.neroruins.nyxara.4.speaker: Nali
log.neroruins.nyxara.4.body: The automatic defenders still patrol their assigned rooms. They turn away from an empty threshold but respond when we enter.
log.neroruins.nyxara.5.title: The Unfixed Signal · 5
log.neroruins.nyxara.5.speaker: Ilyra
log.neroruins.nyxara.5.body: The brighter strokes are not damage. They were added later, over the old binding pattern.
log.neroruins.nyxara.6.title: The Unfixed Signal · 6
log.neroruins.nyxara.6.speaker: Mira
log.neroruins.nyxara.6.body: The passage below was closed from the outside and opened from within. Whatever left here intended the way to be found again.
log.neroruins.lattice.1.title: What Was Left Open · 1
log.neroruins.lattice.1.speaker: Ilyra
log.neroruins.lattice.1.body: These halls use the same marks as Luna, but here their relationships are complete. The pattern begins outside the central hall.
log.neroruins.lattice.2.title: What Was Left Open · 2
log.neroruins.lattice.2.speaker: Mira
log.neroruins.lattice.2.body: The paths meet at a guarded threshold. Every approach returns to that threshold; none enters the inner hall directly.
log.neroruins.lattice.3.title: What Was Left Open · 3
log.neroruins.lattice.3.speaker: Teren
log.neroruins.lattice.3.body: The resonator works only when its three visible channels agree. No line needs power from a machine outside this room.
log.neroruins.lattice.4.title: What Was Left Open · 4
log.neroruins.lattice.4.speaker: Nali
log.neroruins.lattice.4.body: We could not tell a defender from a warning until it moved. Leave space to retreat and do not bring the wounded through first.
log.neroruins.lattice.5.title: What Was Left Open · 5
log.neroruins.lattice.5.speaker: Ilyra
log.neroruins.lattice.5.body: They tried to keep each world exactly as it was. The record became quieter with every correction.
log.neroruins.lattice.6.title: What Was Left Open · 6
log.neroruins.lattice.6.speaker: Ilyra
log.neroruins.lattice.6.body: They opened the binding themselves. The Lattice remembers what changed, including their departure, but it does not say where they went. The pattern is still changing.

codex.neroruins.earth.title: The First Shelter
codex.neroruins.earth.body: Earth sent the Survey to learn, not conquer; the first shelters preserved its first warning.
codex.neroruins.luna.title: Ash Without Fire
codex.neroruins.luna.body: the lunar crews found the first Lattice fragments and learned they responded to motion.
codex.neroruins.ark.title: The Ship That Waited
codex.neroruins.ark.body: the Ark carried people and supplies, and was deliberately separated after its control network fell quiet.
codex.neroruins.mars.title: A Catalogue of Silence
codex.neroruins.mars.body: the Survey learned that the Lattice recorded changes rather than simple speech.
codex.neroruins.cindara.title: The Meridian's Wake
codex.neroruins.cindara.body: the freighter's crew carried a warning after the network began to suppress change.
codex.neroruins.glacira.title: The Frozen Reach
codex.neroruins.glacira.body: the frozen settlement survived the initial network failure by disconnecting its local systems.
codex.neroruins.greenxertz.title: Roots in the Hull
codex.neroruins.greenxertz.body: life continued through abandoned Survey structures and the settlement found new ways to live without the network.
codex.neroruins.nyxara.title: The Unfixed Signal
codex.neroruins.nyxara.body: the Survey found evidence that the Architects deliberately released their network.
codex.neroruins.lattice.title: What Was Left Open
codex.neroruins.lattice.body: the Architects chose release over preserving a fixed pattern; the Lattice remains a record open to change.
